blocks.en: From linear algebra, we know that every Euclidean vector space has a Cartesian basis. In this subsection, we shall extend this result to Hilbert spaces. We shall need the following definition.
blocks.zh: 由线性代数知道, 每个 Euclidean 向量空间都有 Cartesian 基. 本小节将把这一结果推广到 Hilbert 空间. 需要以下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $H$ be a Hilbert space and $I$ a (possibly uncountable) index set. Let $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ be a family of elements of $H$. We say that $\sum_{i\in I}x_i=x$ if at most countably many of the $x_i$ are nonzero, and if for any enumeration of these nonzero elements we have $x=\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}x_{i(j)}$.
blocks.zh: 设 $H$ 为 Hilbert 空间, $I$ 为一个 (可能不可数的) 指标集. 设 $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ 为 $H$ 的一族元素. 若至多可数多个 $x_i$ 非零, 且对这些非零元素的任意枚举都有 $x=\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}x_{i(j)}$, 就说 $\sum_{i\in I}x_i=x$.
blocks.label: def:unordered-hilbert-series-sum

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Note that while it is convenient for us to allow for the possibility of an uncountable index set, at most countably many elements can be nonzero if this notion of convergence is to make sense. To see this, note that for any series of real numbers to be absolutely convergent, it can have at most a finite number of terms with norm greater than, say, $1/n$ for and natural number $n$. Hence, it can have at most countably many nonzero terms. The above definition of convergence is a generalization of absolute convergence of a series of real number, and the following conditions are easily shown to be equivalent to that definition. We leave the proof to the reader (Problem~\ref{ex:hilbert-series-convergence-criteria}).
blocks.zh: 注意, 虽然允许指标集可能不可数会给我们带来方便, 但要使这一收敛概念有意义, 就至多只能有可数多个非零元素. 为说明这一点, 注意一个实数级数若绝对收敛, 则对于自然数 $n$, 范数大于例如 $1/n$ 的项至多只有有限个. 因而它至多只有可数多个非零项. 上述收敛定义推广了实数级数的绝对收敛, 以下条件容易证明与该定义等价. 证明留给读者 (Problem~\ref{ex:hilbert-series-convergence-criteria}).
blocks.label: rem:unordered-series-countability

blocks.en: A family $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ of mutually orthogonal elements of $H$ is called \textbf{orthonormal} if $\|x_i\|=1$ for every $i\in I$.
blocks.zh: 若对每个 $i\in I$ 都有 $\|x_i\|=1$, 则称 $H$ 中一族两两正交的元素 $\{x_i\}_{i\in I}$ \textbf{标准正交}.
blocks.label: def:orthonormal-family
